Description
Due to a high-quality and internationally renowned gold bullion product, a 1 oz Valcambi gold bar in the assay is a popular choice for investors. Valcambi is a top-rated swiss refinery in Switzerland that produces only high-quality products & ensures that the product is of high purity and weight. Every Valcambi gold bullions are designed around 100 grams with almost the same rectangular design. In contrast, the Valcambi gold bar contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold entitled for precious metals IRAs.
The bar is packaged with an assay card with the same information as the bar, such as weight, purity, and serial number. This style is straightforward and attractive, making the bar recognized and verifiable.
The 1 oz Valcambi gold bar is wrapped on a tamper-evident assay card, which provides additional security and protection for the gold. This method of purchasing gold is not only less expensive than buying coins, but it is also easier to buy and sell on the secondary market. This product is also known for highly liquidy products that can be easily purchased or sold in the global market.
Design of 1 oz Valcambi Gold Bar in Assay
The 1 oz Valcambi Gold Bar in Assay is normally designed in a basic yet attractive style symbolizing the company brand name on the lower left side with its emblem on the right side. The bar also has a unique serial number stamped on it, allowing for simple identification and authentication.
The reverse side of these gold bars contains one simple engraving with the brand name on the left side with 90 degree rotation, i.e., “Valcambi Suisse,” that includes an assay card for verifying the gold bar’s weight, purity, and serial number.
Highlights of Valcambi 1 oz Gold Bar In Assay
Each product contains 1 Troy oz of .9999 pure gold.
The product is designed by Valcambi.
Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
On the observed side, the gold product features a single stamped Valcambi emblem, weight, and purity.
On the reverse side, the features of Valcambi Suisse are simply excellence.
Each product is presented in sealed protective assay packaging.
